notes: Pre-commencement communication (SC TO-C; the box 'relates solely to preliminary communications made before the commencement of a tender offer' is checked). The tender is only PROPOSED: the adviser has recommended that the Board approve it, and it is contingent on Board approval and on shareholder approval of the holding-company conversion Proposals at the Special Meeting on August 20, 2021. Size is stated only in dollars, 'up to $50 million in aggregate value of Common Shares', so size_shares and size_pct_outstanding are null. Timing: 'expected to commence as soon as practicable after the date of shareholder approval of the Proposals, but in any event not later than 60 days after such date'; no commencement or expiration date is stated. trigger_origin 'other': the tender is part of a proposal to convert the Fund to a diversified holding company (described as 'additional shareholder liquidity during the conversion process' and a response to 'feedback received from shareholders during the solicitation process'); merger_related would be the nearest alternative. The conversion proposal itself (vote at the August 20, 2021 Special Meeting; deregistration under the 1940 Act; implementation projected to run to about mid-2023) is a separate structural event that fits no schema kind cleanly (liquidation/action=other at most) and is recorded here rather than as a second event. The text file encodes apostrophes and quotation marks as C1 control characters (U+0092/U+0093/U+0094); spans were chosen to avoid them.
